fixed_frame_rival.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define fill-rings (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((markers (let loop
                                ((k 0) (acc (list)))
                                (cond
                                  ((>= k (min h w)) (reverse acc))
                                  (else (let ((v (at g k k)))
                                          (cond
                                            ((and (!= v 0) (!= v 1)) (loop (+ k 1) (cons v acc)))
                                            (else (loop (+ k 1) acc))))))))
                  (blues (find-color g 1))
                  (fr1 (+ (min-of first blues) 1))
                  (fc1 (+ (min-of second blues) 1))
                  (fr2 (- (max-of first blues) 1))
                  (fc2 (- (max-of second blues) 1))
                  (painted (make-hash)))
             (let loop
                  ((r1 fr1) (c1 fc1) (r2 fr2) (c2 fc2) (ms markers))
                  (when
                    (and (not (null? ms)) (<= r1 r2) (<= c1 c2))
                    (let ((clr (car ms)))
                      (for* ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1))))
                            (hash-set! painted (list r c) clr))
                      (loop (+ r1 1) (+ c1 1) (- r2 1) (- c2 1) (cdr ms)))))
             (cellmap g
                      (r c v)
                      (cond
                        ((hash-has-key? painted (list r c)) (hash-ref painted (list r c)))
                        (else v)))))))
  (define after-a (fill-rings g))
  (define palette
    (filter (lambda (v) (and (!= v 0) (!= v 1)))
      (for/list ((k (range 0 (min (rows g) (cols g))))) (at g k k))))
  (define center-color (last palette))
  (define blues (find-color g 1))
  (define r1 (min-of first blues))
  (define c1 (min-of second blues))
  (define r2 (max-of first blues))
  (define c2 (max-of second blues))
  (define (count-center state)
    (for*/sum ((r (range (+ r1 1) r2)) (c (range (+ c1 1) c2)))
      (if (= (at state r c) center-color) 1 0)))
  (define key-area (* (- 13 (* 2 (length palette))) (- 14 (* 2 (length palette)))))
  (define keys
    (filter
      (lambda (o)
        (and (!= (obj-color o) 1) (> (obj-size o) 1)
          (for/and ((p (obj-cells o)))
            (and (!= (first p) (second p))
                 (not (and (<= r1 (first p) r2) (<= c1 (second p) c2)))))))
      (objects g 0)))
  (define matches (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-size o) key-area)) keys))
  (if (null? matches) after-a
    (let ((target (car matches)))
      (cellmap after-a (r c v)
        (if (and (<= (obj-r1 target) r (obj-r2 target))
                 (<= (obj-c1 target) c (obj-c2 target)))
            center-color v))))))
